actions.name: Bulldoze
actions.description: Activate when attempting a bull rush or reposition combat maneuver. The mech gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll, and if the maneuver succeeds, the target also takes damage equal to the mech's tier plus its Strength modifier.

description.value:
Reinforcements to the lower limbs enable terrain traversal.

Effect: Treat difficult terrain as normal terrain.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Bulldoze} Gain a +2 bonus to bull rush and reposition combat maneuvers. On a successful maneuver, deal damage equal to the mech's tier plus its Strength modifier.
